put.description: Updates an existing user with the provided information. All fields are optional - only provided fields will be updated.

requestBody.description: User information to update (all fields optional)

password.description: New password for the user (will be hashed)

email.description: Updated email address of the user

description.description: Updated description or notes about the user

404.description: Not found - user does not exist

message.example: Cannot disable the last remaining super admin user. At least one active super admin must exist in the system.

delete.description: Delete a user from the system. Prevents deletion of the last remaining super admin to avoid system lockout. If user owns zones, you must specify transfer_to_user_id to transfer zones to another user.

requestBody.description: Zone transfer options (required if user owns zones)

transfer_to_user_id.description: User ID to transfer zones to (required if user owns zones)

404.description: Not found - user to delete or transfer target user does not exist

400.description: Bad request - user owns zones and no transfer target was provided

message.example: User owns zones. Please specify transfer_to_user_id to transfer zones to another user.

409.description: Conflict - cannot delete the last remaining super admin

message.example: Cannot delete the last remaining super admin user. At least one super admin must exist in the system.

post.description: Creates a new DNS zone with the provided information

requestBody.description: Zone information for creating a new DNS zone

master.description: Master server(s) for SLAVE zones. Supports: "192.0.2.1" (plain IP), "192.0.2.1,192.0.2.2" (multiple), "192.0.2.1:5300" (with port). IPv6 with port needs brackets: "[2001:db8::1]:5300"

template.description: Zone template ID to use (get IDs from GET /api/v2/zone-templates)

owner_user_id.description: User ID to assign as zone owner. Defaults to the authenticated user when omitted (even if group_ids is supplied). Send an explicit null to opt out of user ownership and create a group-only zone (requires zone_ownership_mode that allows groups and a non-empty group_ids). Specifying a different user requires zone_content_edit_others permission.

group_ids.description: Optional list of group IDs to assign as zone owners. Requires user_is_ueberuser permission to assign arbitrary groups.

soa_edit_api.description: Per-zone SOA-EDIT-API serial policy. Omit to apply the dns.soa_edit_api default; send OFF to disable the policy for this zone. Values not offered by the server are rejected with 400 for every zone type, unlike the web form which ignores them. The available set is narrowed by the dns.soa_edit_api_options config list. A SLAVE zone takes its serial from the primary, so the accepted value is not applied there.
